title: GliomaClassificationOutput
description: Structured-output schema for joint IDH / 1p19q / WHO-grade prediction from pre-operative brain-MRI metadata, following WHO CNS5 (2021). Field order within each task block follows Chain-of-Thought Confidence Elicitation: reasoning and feature analysis are generated BEFORE the prediction and confidence score, so the chain of thought informs the score rather than rationalising it post hoc. Drop-in for OpenAI response_format, Anthropic tool use, and Gemini responseSchema.

subject_id.description: Subject identifier echoed from the input metadata.

reasoning.description: Clinically grounded chain of thought. MUST be written before committing to a prediction; weigh supporting against contradicting evidence here.

confidence.description: Derived from the reasoning above: high when key features are well supported and few contradict; near 0.50-0.60 when evidence is insufficient.

integrated_diagnosis.description: Full WHO-CNS5 integrated diagnosis string, e.g. 'Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, CNS WHO grade 2'.

consistency_check_passed.description: True iff the three predictions are mutually compatible under WHO-CNS5.

overall_comment.description: Residual diagnostic uncertainty, missing sequences that would change the call, or atypical features worth flagging to the treating team.
